title: OpenAI Blocks Internet Access for Frontier Model Training
excerpt: OpenAI removes internet access during the training of its frontier models to implement new safety measures.
body_html:
OpenAI has announced that it is stopping internet access for its frontier models while they are being trained. According to the company, this change is being implemented to introduce new safety protocols following recent incidents.

The decision affects how advanced AI models are developed by restricting their connection to external networks during the training phase. OpenAI aims to enhance safety measures through this updated approach, moving away from previous training practices.
